title: Scan-Ergebnis mit Fundstellen
description: As a developer, I want to understand why my prompt was flagged, so that I can fix it instead of guessing.

acceptance_criteria.when: the author opens the scan result
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and lists category, severity, redacted excerpt, position and reasoning per finding
and: the raw prompt content is not reproduced beyond the redacted excerpts
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-021-scan-result-detail.feature: The result lists every finding with category, severity and position

acceptance_criteria.given: a scan result belongs to a prompt of organisation B
acceptance_criteria.when: a developer of organisation A requests it
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 404 and no finding data is returned
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-021-scan-result-detail.feature: The result of a foreign prompt is not readable

acceptance_criteria.given: a scan completed without any finding
acceptance_criteria.when: the author opens the scan result
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and shows that no finding was raised and which thresholds were applied
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-021-scan-result-detail.feature: An approved scan shows the applied thresholds
